edition: V5 / desktop-only bake. No URL here is a browser dependency.
order: band, south-to-north row, eastward column, uint8 gzip

observations.cover.bin.gz: ESA WorldCover v200 2021 / CC BY 4.0; crop, grass, shrub, bare, wetland, mangrove, built: sampled percentages (64 native categorical observations per 1.018 km block). Original receipts in frozen/SOURCES.json.
observations.soil.bin.gz: Tomislav Hengl (2018), OpenLandMap USDA surface texture / CC BY-SA 4.0, doi:10.5281/zenodo.2525817. Regional resampling, shared under the same licence. Texture is not measured colour, soil series or crop identity.
observations.rock.bin.gz: Hartmann & Moosdorf (2012), GLiM v1.0, 0.5° dominant lithology / CC BY 3.0, doi:10.1594/PANGAEA.788537. Not a cliff or outcrop survey.
observations.rain.bin.gz: NASA POWER / MERRA-2 corrected precipitation climatology, 20010101–20251231, (17, 15), mm/day ×20. NASA open data; not live or site-specific rainfall.
observations.coast-km.bin.gz: Distance to rasterized Natural Earth 1:10m physical coastline, public domain, km rounded/capped at 254. 255 outside.
observations.lake-mean.bin.gz: HydroLAKES v1.0, Messager et al. 2016 / CC BY 4.0; lake-average modelled depth in half-metres, NOT local bathymetry. Zero = no positive sampled value.
observations.ocean.bin.gz: Natural Earth 1:10m ocean polygons (public domain), regional screen grid; not hydrographic sounding data.
observations.waterfalls.json: Filtered nodes waterway=waterfall from the pinned Geofabrik Southern Zone OSM edition; © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0; coordinates and names unchanged, cell is a derived index. See frozen/SOURCES.json. No invented waterfalls.
observations.ocean-mesh.json: Natural Earth 1:10m ocean polygons (public domain), projected, clipped in 64-cell sectors, simplified at 0.32 acre side and quantized to 1/32 acre side. Continuous marine horizon, not a local hydrographic survey.
